critical_finding.finding: The nine NBA games OLBG listed at capture are the MONDAY 26 OCTOBER slate, not Tuesday 27 October. Confirmed by ESPN's own odds board, which stamps Miami/Indiana/Milwaukee, Phoenix/Oklahoma City, Atlanta/Houston and Golden State/Denver with UTC start times of 2026-10-27T00:00Z to T02:00Z - i.e. Monday evening in the United States.
critical_finding.why_it_matters: Presenting those nine games as upcoming on Tuesday 27 October would publish predictions for matches that have already tipped off or finished. They are recorded here as a closed market reference only.
critical_finding.today_slate: The genuine Tuesday 27 October NBA card is four games: Brooklyn Nets @ Boston Celtics (7:30 PM ET), Sacramento Kings @ San Antonio Spurs (8:00 PM ET), Detroit Pistons @ New York Knicks (8:00 PM ET) and Portland Trail Blazers @ Los Angeles Lakers (11:00 PM ET). OLBG's basketball hub at live capture time showed NO NBA listings at all - it was entirely EuroLeague, EuroCup, Basketball Champions League and Korean KBL. So OLBG has no crowd tip data for today's NBA card.
critical_finding.consequence: For basketball, predictions are written from market and independent-projection sources for the four Tuesday games, and OLBG tip data is used only for the European competitions where OLBG does list today's matches. This gap is published on the Flagged page.
